# A&M Electronics Repair

> Locally owned phone, tablet, computer and game console repair shop in Jacksonville, Arkansas (USA), serving Central Arkansas including Sherwood, Cabot, North Little Rock and Little Rock. Free diagnostics, 30-day warranty on parts and labor, walk-ins welcome Monday–Saturday 10 AM–8 PM.

## Key facts

- Business name: A&M Electronics Repair
- Address: 14218 AR-107, Jacksonville, AR 72076, USA (Jacksonville, AR — not Florida or North Carolina)
- Phone: (501) 492-9906
- Website: https://am-electronicsrepair.org
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 10:00 AM–8:00 PM; closed Sunday
- Appointments: not required; walk-ins welcome; phone quotes available
- Diagnostics: free, no obligation; customer approves the exact price before any work
- Warranty: 30 days on parts and labor for every repair
- Starting prices: iPhone repair from $49; game console repair from $49; Samsung repair from $59; tablet repair from $59; computer repair from $59
- Typical turnaround: iPhone screen about 30 minutes; Samsung about 45 minutes; computers, tablets and consoles usually same-day
- Google rating: 5.0 stars

## Services

- [iPhone Repair](https://am-electronicsrepair.org/services/iphone-repair): screens (OEM-grade), batteries, charging ports, cameras, water damage, speakers, software. iPhone 6 through current models.
- [Samsung Repair](https://am-electronicsrepair.org/services/samsung-repair): Galaxy S, A and Note series; OLED screens (not LCD), batteries, charging ports, back glass, cameras.
- [Computer & MacBook Repair](https://am-electronicsrepair.org/services/computer-repair): SSD and RAM upgrades, virus removal, screens, keyboards, overheating, data recovery; Windows PCs, MacBooks and iMacs.
- [Game Console Repair](https://am-electronicsrepair.org/services/game-console-repair): PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch; HDMI ports, disc drives, overheating, Joy-Con drift, controllers.
- [Tablet & iPad Repair](https://am-electronicsrepair.org/services/tablet-repair): iPad, Samsung Galaxy Tab, Amazon Fire and Android tablets; screens, digitizers, batteries, charging ports.

## Service area

- [Service areas and drive times](https://am-electronicsrepair.org/service-areas): Jacksonville (home base), Sherwood (~5 min), North Little Rock (~12 min), Little Rock (~18 min), Cabot (~20 min), Maumelle (~22 min), Bryant (~30 min), Conway (~35 min), Benton (~40 min).
